snippets.text: SwiftCart's average cost per delivery rose from 5.00 credits in 2024 to 5.40 credits in 2025. Higher fuel and labour costs were cited in its fictional annual report.
The fictional delivery company SwiftCart completed 1 million deliveries in 2025, up from 800,000 in 2024. Its on-time delivery rate rose from 90% to 92%.
The same 2025 online grocery survey found that 360 of 600 online buyers valued delivery reliability most. The survey did not ask respondents to rank every purchasing factor.

draft_memo.title: Assessment of SwiftCart Delivery Growth, Reliability, and Costs
draft_memo.body:
SwiftCart completed 1 million deliveries in 2025, an increase from 800,000 in 2024 [P05]. This growth is accompanied by an improvement in its on-time delivery rate, which rose from 90% to 92% during the same period [P05]. These figures indicate a positive trend in both the volume of deliveries and the reliability of service. The data does not report the average delivery time for SwiftCart deliveries. The data does not report the number of customers served in 2025.

However, the average cost per delivery rose from 5.00 credits in 2024 to 5.40 credits in 2025 [P06]. Higher fuel and labor costs were cited as contributing factors in SwiftCart's annual report [P06]. This increase in costs presents a challenge for the company. The data does not report the total revenue generated from these deliveries.

The data does have limitations, particularly regarding the survey on delivery reliability. While 360 out of 600 online buyers indicated that delivery reliability was their top priority, the survey did not ask respondents to rank every purchasing factor [P08]. This lack of comprehensive ranking means that the importance of delivery reliability relative to other factors remains unclear. The data does not report the demographics of the survey respondents.

Additionally, there is missing data that could provide a more complete picture of SwiftCart's performance. Information on customer satisfaction ratings, reasons for delivery delays, and comparative costs with competitors would be valuable for a thorough assessment. Without this data, it is challenging to fully evaluate SwiftCart's position in the market and the implications of its growth and cost increases.
